 Our Goal is to answer this question Is there a difference between the alcohol consumed between the row
 you choose to sit in??

# Introduction 
The question is this: Is there a relationship between where you sit in class and how much you drink?

Data from UC DAVIS MATH 116 CLASS

$H_0$ There is no relationship between where you sit in class and how much you drink.

$H_A$ There is a relationship between where you sit in class and how much you drink. 


# Methods
Seat is categorical. 
Alcohol is numerical.


# Data Summaries 


## Now add in boxplot

```{r}
boxplot(alcohol~Seat,data=davisdata)
```
The graph demonstrates that the students who sit in the back tend to consume more ounces per week alcohol than the students who sit in the middle and the front. 
  


## Numerical Summaries
```{r}
favstats(alcohol~Seat,data=davisdata)
```
The numerical summary shows that the students who sit in the back drink more ounces per week than the students who sit in the middle and the front.
